description: The standard natural numbers satisfy \(\Box_T A\to A\) for every arithmetic sentence \(A\) if and only if every actual \(T\)-theorem is true in the standard natural numbers.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FormalizedProvability.standard_reflection_iff_sound
  {T : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Theory}
  (P : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FormalizedProvability.ProofRepresentation T) :
  (∀ (σ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Sentence),
      ℕ ⊨
        FirstOrder.Language.Formula.imp (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FormalizedProvability.provabilitySentence P σ)
          σ) ↔
    ∀ (σ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Sentence),
      Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T σ → ℕ ⊨ σ
